title: Right Turn, Clyde
intro: Someone left you a "working" program. Run it, watch the HP bar, then fix it. Hitting stone costs [b]15 HP[/b].
cs_note: Turns are relative to the robot's facing, not to the screen. Most bugs aren't typos; they come from a wrong mental model. Debugging means comparing what you expected with what actually happened.
hints: Step through the program with [b]Step[/b] and watch which way the robot faces after each turn.
Two of the blocks are swapped.
